question_text: What is the role of the sodium-potassium pump in a neuron?

options.text:

To maintain the resting membrane potential

Synapses only occur in the spinal cord

question_text: Which of the following statements about the nervous system is correct?

options.text:

The central nervous system includes the brain and spinal cord.

The peripheral nervous system consists of the brain only.

Myelin sheath slows down impulse conduction.

options.text:

Electrical synapses allow direct ion flow between neurons.

Neurotransmitters are released at chemical synapses.

All synapses in the human body are electrical synapses.

Calcium ions play a role in neurotransmitter release.

subject: Biology

question_text: Which of the following statements about the autonomic nervous system is correct?

options.text:

It regulates involuntary functions like heart rate and digestion.

It consists only of the sympathetic nervous system.

It does not influence glandular secretion.

Regulation of body temperature, hunger, and thirst

It is only found in the central nervous system.

Processing visual, auditory, and motor information

options.text:
(1)
It consists of the brain and spinal cord.

It does not communicate with the peripheral nervous system.

It is not protected by any membrane.

The central nervous system (CNS) consists of the brain and spinal cord, which control voluntary and

Calcium ions trigger neurotransmitter release at the synapse.

Neurotransmitter release occurs only at chemical synapses.

It consists of the brain and spinal cord.

It includes cranial and spinal nerves.

It does not interact with the central nervous system.

question_text: Which of the following statements about the myelin sheath is correct?

options.text:

It speeds up the transmission of nerve impulses.

It covers all neurons in the body.

source: ScienceLesson.in — Biology / Neural Control and Coordination / Test 3

source: ScienceLesson.in — Biology / Neural Control and Coordination / Test 4

question_text: Which of the following statements about the sympathetic nervous system is incorrect?

options.text:
(1)
It is part of the autonomic nervous system.

It promotes the "fight or flight" response.

It decreases heart rate and promotes digestion.

It increases blood pressure and respiration rate.

The sympathetic nervous system increases heart rate and inhibits digestion as part of the "fight or

source: ScienceLesson.in — Biology / Neural Control and Coordination / Test 4

options.text:

It controls voluntary actions and higher cognitive functions.

It is mainly responsible for involuntary reflexes.

It regulates heart rate and breathing.

It is located in the brainstem.

source: ScienceLesson.in — Biology / Neural Control and Coordination / Test 4

Neurotransmitters directly enter the postsynaptic neuron.

It increases heart rate and blood pressure.

question_text: Which of the following structures is part of the peripheral nervous system (PNS)?

source: ScienceLesson.in — Biology / Neural Control and Coordination / Test 4

Shock absorption for the brain and spinal cord

The peripheral nervous system consists of cranial and spinal nerves.

The central nervous system includes only the spinal cord.

question_text: Which of the following statements about the sodium-potassium pump is incorrect?
